WITH r AS (
  SELECT $1::TEXT action,$2::TEXT clinic_name,NULLIF($3::BIGINT,0) doctor_id,
         NULLIF($4::TEXT,'') doctor_name,NULLIF($5::TEXT,'') title,
         NULLIF($6::TEXT,'') specialty,NULLIF($7::TEXT,'') phone,
         NULLIF($8::TEXT,'') email,$9::INTEGER buffer_minutes,
         NULLIF($10::TEXT,'') calendar_id,$11::JSONB metadata,
         NULLIF($12::TEXT,'') actor_name,$13::TEXT source_channel,
         $14::INTEGER result_limit
),
c AS (
  SELECT clinics.id clinic_id,r.*
  FROM clinics,r
  WHERE clinics.name=r.clinic_name
  LIMIT 1
),
target AS (
  SELECT d.*
  FROM doctors d,c
  WHERE d.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
    AND (
      (c.doctor_id IS NOT NULL AND d.id=c.doctor_id)
      OR
      (c.doctor_id IS NULL AND c.doctor_name IS NOT NULL AND d.full_name=c.doctor_name)
    )
  ORDER BY d.id
  LIMIT 1
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO doctors(
    clinic_id,full_name,title,specialty,phone,email,buffer_minutes,
    calendar_id,is_active,metadata,updated_at
  )
  SELECT c.clinic_id,c.doctor_name,c.title,c.specialty,c.phone,c.email,
         c.buffer_minutes,c.calendar_id,TRUE,c.metadata,NOW()
  FROM c
  WHERE c.action='create'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target)
  RETURNING *
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE doctors d
  SET full_name=CASE WHEN c.action='update' AND c.doctor_name IS NOT NULL THEN c.doctor_name ELSE d.full_name END,
      title=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN COALESCE(c.title,d.title) ELSE d.title END,
      specialty=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN COALESCE(c.specialty,d.specialty) ELSE d.specialty END,
      phone=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN COALESCE(c.phone,d.phone) ELSE d.phone END,
      email=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN COALESCE(c.email,d.email) ELSE d.email END,
      buffer_minutes=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN c.buffer_minutes ELSE d.buffer_minutes END,
      calendar_id=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN COALESCE(c.calendar_id,d.calendar_id) ELSE d.calendar_id END,
      metadata=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN d.metadata||c.metadata ELSE d.metadata END,
      is_active=CASE WHEN c.action='activate' THEN TRUE WHEN c.action='deactivate' THEN FALSE ELSE d.is_active END,
      updated_at=NOW()
  FROM c
  WHERE d.id=(SELECT id FROM target)
    AND c.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate')
  RETURNING d.*
),
effective AS (
  SELECT inserted.* FROM inserted
  UNION ALL
  SELECT updated.* FROM updated
  UNION ALL
  SELECT target.* FROM target,c WHERE c.action='get'
  LIMIT 1
),
admin_event AS (
  INSERT INTO clinic_admin_events(
    clinic_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,actor_name,source_channel,before_data,after_data
  )
  SELECT
    c.clinic_id,'doctor',
    COALESCE((SELECT id FROM effective),(SELECT id FROM target)),
    c.action,c.actor_name,c.source_channel,
    COALESCE((SELECT TO_JSONB(target) FROM target),'{}'::JSONB),
    COALESCE((SELECT TO_JSONB(effective) FROM effective),'{}'::JSONB)
  FROM c
  WHERE c.action IN ('create','update','activate','deactivate')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective)
  RETURNING id
),
listed AS (
  SELECT d.id,d.full_name,d.title,d.specialty,d.phone,d.email,d.buffer_minutes,
         d.calendar_id,d.is_active,d.metadata,d.created_at,d.updated_at,
         COALESCE((
           SELECT COUNT(*)
           FROM doctor_services ds
           WHERE ds.doctor_id=d.id AND ds.is_active=TRUE
         ),0) active_service_count
  FROM doctors d,c
  WHERE c.action='list'
    AND d.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
  ORDER BY d.full_name,d.id
  LIMIT (SELECT result_limit FROM c)
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN FALSE
       WHEN c.action='create' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN FALSE
       WHEN c.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate','get') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN FALSE
       ELSE TRUE END success,
  CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN 'clinic_not_found'
       WHEN c.action='create' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 'doctor_already_exists'
       WHEN c.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate','get') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 'doctor_not_found'
       WHEN c.action='create' THEN 'doctor_created'
       WHEN c.action='update' THEN 'doctor_updated'
       WHEN c.action='activate' THEN 'doctor_activated'
       WHEN c.action='deactivate' THEN 'doctor_deactivated'
       WHEN c.action='get' THEN 'doctor_loaded'
       ELSE 'doctors_listed' END result,
  (SELECT TO_JSONB(effective) FROM effective) doctor,
  COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(listed)) FROM listed),'[]'::JSONB) doctors,
  (SELECT id FROM admin_event) admin_event_id
FROM c
UNION ALL
SELECT FALSE,'clinic_not_found',NULL::JSONB,'[]'::JSONB,NULL::BIGINT
FROM r
WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c);

## مدیریت پزشکان

اقدام‌ها: create, update, activate, deactivate, get, list

نام، تخصص، Buffer، Calendar ID و Metadata قابل مدیریت است.
